summary: The Chiropractic Board of Australia sets the standards for clinical practice,  record-keeping, and advertising for chiropractors under the National Registration  and Accreditation Scheme.
The Dental Board of Australia, under AHPRA, mandates strict standards for clinical documentation, radiograph justification, and informed consent for all dental practitioners.

The Medical Board of Australia, supported by AHPRA, sets the Good Medical Practice standards that govern clinical record-keeping, prescribing, and professional conduct for all registered medical practitioners in Australia.
The Osteopathy Board of Australia, under AHPRA, mandates strict standards for clinical documentation, informed consent, and professional conduct to ensure patient safety and continuity of care.

The Occupational Therapy Board of Australia (OTBA) sets the professional standards, codes of conduct, and registration requirements for occupational therapists in Australia under the Health Practitioner Regulation National Law.

The Physiotherapy Board of Australia sets the national standards for practice,  record-keeping, and ethical conduct for all registered physiotherapists under  the Health Practitioner Regulation National Law.
The Podiatry Board of Australia sets the professional standards, codes, and guidelines that podiatrists must meet to ensure safe, ethical, and evidence-based clinical practice.

fullName: Australian Radiation Protection and Nuclear Safety Agency — Radiation Protection in Dentistry
summary: ARPANSA's Radiation Protection Series No. 10 and state radiation protection legislation require that every dental radiograph is clinically justified, exposure minimised, and findings documented. Compliance is enforced by state radiation health authorities.

The Australian Veterinary Association (AVA) Code of Professional Conduct and state Veterinary Practitioners Boards (VPB) set the statutory standards for clinical record-keeping, drug management, and professional accountability in Australia.

fullName: Royal Australian College of General Practitioners — Standards for General Practices (5th Edition)
summary: The RACGP Standards (5th edition) are used for accreditation of Australian GP practices. Health record standards (Criterion C1.1) require structured, contemporaneous, attributable records, secure storage, and privacy-compliant access controls.
Speech Pathology Australia (SPA) sets the professional standards and Code of Ethics for speech pathologists in Australia, ensuring high-quality, evidence-based, and safe clinical practice.

fullName: Veterinary Practitioners Boards — State and Territory (Australia)
summary: State and territory Veterinary Practitioners Boards (VPBs) in NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, and ACT administer registration, conduct investigations, and inspect clinical records for compliance with state-level veterinary practice legislation.

fullName: Competition and Markets Authority — Veterinary Services Remedies 2026
summary: Twenty-one binding remedies from the CMA's 2024 Veterinary Services Market Investigation. Core compliance obligations: upfront price display, written estimates before treatment, prescription transparency, complaints logging, and itemised invoicing.

fullName: Care Quality Commission and General Dental Council (UK)
summary: This framework ensures dental practices meet CQC Regulation 17 (Good Governance) and GDC Standards for the Dental Team, focusing on contemporaneous record-keeping, informed consent, and clinical safety.

fullName: Care Quality Commission and General Medical Council
summary: This framework aligns Salvia’s clinical documentation with CQC Regulation 17 (Good Governance) and the GMC’s Good Medical Practice standards for UK General Practice.
The General Chiropractic Council (GCC) sets the statutory standards for chiropractic practice in the UK, mandating rigorous record-keeping, patient autonomy, and clinical accountability.

The General Osteopathic Council (GOsC) sets the Osteopathic Practice Standards (OPS) for all osteopaths in the UK, mandating rigorous clinical record-keeping, informed consent, and professional conduct.
The HCPC sets the statutory Standards of Proficiency and Conduct for occupational therapists in the UK, mandating clear, accurate, and contemporaneous clinical record-keeping.

The HCPC sets the statutory standards of conduct, performance, and ethics for physiotherapists in the UK, ensuring that all records are accurate, contemporaneous, and support the safe delivery of care.

The HCPC sets the statutory standards of conduct, performance, and ethics for podiatrists in the UK. Salvia ensures your clinical records meet these requirements through structured documentation, audit trails, and evidence-based clinical pathways.
The HCPC sets the statutory standards of conduct, performance, and ethics for Speech and Language Therapists in the UK, requiring clear, accurate, and contemporaneous record-keeping.

fullName: Royal College of Veterinary Surgeons Practice Standards Scheme
summary: The RCVS Practice Standards Scheme (PSS) sets the quality assurance framework for veterinary practices in the UK, ensuring clinical governance, record-keeping, and patient safety standards are met.

fullName: Veterinary Medicines Regulations 2013 (as amended) — United Kingdom
summary: The VMR governs prescribing, dispensing, administration, and disposal of veterinary medicines in the UK, including controlled drug register requirements for Schedule 2 and 3 substances. Non-compliance is a criminal offence.

CORU's Occupational Therapists Registration Board sets the statutory standards of conduct, ethics, and record-keeping for every registered occupational therapist practising in Ireland under the Health and Social Care Professionals Act 2005.

CORU's Physiotherapists Registration Board sets the statutory standards of conduct, ethics and record-keeping for every registered physiotherapist practising in Ireland under the Health and Social Care Professionals Act 2005.

The Podiatrists Registration Board under CORU sets the statutory standards of practice, conduct, and record-keeping for podiatrists in Ireland. Salvia ensures these clinical obligations are met through structured, contemporaneous, and auditable documentation.
CORU's Speech & Language Therapists Registration Board sets the statutory standards of conduct, ethics, and record-keeping for speech and language therapists practising in Ireland.

fullName: Dental Council of Ireland — Standards Guidance for Dental Practitioners
summary: The Dental Council of Ireland (DCI) is the statutory regulator for dental practitioners under the Dentists Act 1985. Council standards require contemporaneous, complete clinical records, informed consent, radiograph justification, and secure retention for 7 years.

fullName: Medical Council of Ireland — Guide to Professional Conduct and Ethics
summary: The Medical Council of Ireland (MCI) regulates doctors under the Medical Practitioners Act 2007. The Guide to Professional Conduct and Ethics requires contemporaneous, complete clinical records, informed consent, safe prescribing documentation, and GDPR-compliant data practices.

fullName: Veterinary Council of Ireland Code of Professional Conduct
summary: The Veterinary Council of Ireland (VCI) sets registration and professional conduct standards for veterinary practitioners in Ireland under the Veterinary Practice Act 2005. Clinical record-keeping, consent, and controlled drug registers are mandatory for all registered vets.

fullName: Ayushman Bharat — Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana — Empanelment & Claims Documentation
summary: AB-PMJAY is India's flagship public health-assurance scheme. Empanelled hospitals (EHCPs) treat beneficiaries cashlessly against defined Health Benefit Packages, and must document beneficiary verification, pre-authorisation, treatment, and discharge for claims — with accreditation influencing incentives and rates.

fullName: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission — ABHA, Health Facility Registry & Health Data Standards
summary: The Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) is India's national digital-health backbone — ABHA health IDs, the Health Facility and Healthcare Professionals Registries, and consent-based, interoperable (FHIR) health records. ABDM compliance enables linking records to a patient's ABHA and participating in the national health exchange.

fullName: Central Government Health Scheme — Empanelment Conditions & Record Requirements
summary: The Central Government Health Scheme empanels private hospitals, clinics, dental and diagnostic centres to treat CGHS beneficiaries at notified package rates. Empanelment typically requires NABH/NABL accreditation and disciplined treatment, billing, and record documentation against CGHS rate lists.

fullName: Clinical Establishments (Registration and Regulation) Act, 2010 & Rules
summary: The Clinical Establishments Act, 2010 requires registration of clinical establishments and adherence to minimum standards, including maintenance and reporting of patient records and electronic health records in the prescribed formats. It is adopted across many states and union territories.

fullName: Dentists Act, 1948 & Dental Council of India — Professional Conduct & Records
summary: The Dental Council of India, under the Dentists Act, 1948, regulates dental practice and professional conduct in India. Registered dentists must maintain proper clinical records, obtain informed consent, and prescribe responsibly — the dental analogue of the NMC conduct duties.

India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 governs the processing of digital personal data — including patient and client health data. It requires notice and consent, purpose limitation, security safeguards, breach notification, and honouring data-principal rights such as access, correction, and erasure.

fullName: National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers — Standards for Small Healthcare Organisations (SHCO) / Entry-Level Certification
summary: NABH accreditation is India's primary quality benchmark for clinics and hospitals. Its Information Management System (IMS) standards require complete, legible, contemporaneous medical records with documented consent, retention, and audit controls. NABH Entry-Level certification is a gatekeeper for CGHS empanelment and higher PM-JAY package rates.

fullName: NABH — Accreditation Standards for Dental Healthcare Service Providers
summary: NABH publishes dedicated accreditation standards for dental facilities. They require complete, attributable dental records, documented informed consent for procedures, infection-control and radiation documentation, and secure retention — the dental-specific analogue of NABH's clinical record standards.

fullName: National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories — Medical Testing (ISO 15189)
summary: NABL accredits medical and diagnostic laboratories in India against ISO 15189. It requires controlled documentation of the total testing process — request, sample identification, results, validation, and reporting — with traceability and retention. NABL accreditation is often a prerequisite for CGHS/PM-JAY lab empanelment.

fullName: National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions Act, 2021
summary: The NCAHP Act, 2021 establishes statutory regulation of allied and healthcare professionals in India — physiotherapists, occupational therapists, and others. Registered professionals must practise within their scope, maintain proper clinical records, and obtain documented consent for treatment.

fullName: National Medical Commission — Registered Medical Practitioner (Professional Conduct) Regulations, 2023
summary: The NMC (successor to the Medical Council of India) sets the professional-conduct rules for registered medical practitioners in India. Practitioners must maintain medical records for at least 3 years, supply them to patients within a defined window, and prescribe legibly using generic names.

fullName: Indian Veterinary Council Act, 1984 & Veterinary Council of India — Standards of Professional Conduct
summary: The Veterinary Council of India, under the Indian Veterinary Council Act, 1984, regulates veterinary practice and the conduct of registered veterinary practitioners. Practitioners must keep proper case records, maintain a drug register for scheduled medicines, obtain owner consent, and prescribe responsibly.

The Chiropractic Board of New Zealand (CBNZ) sets the standards for ethical and professional conduct under the HPCA Act, requiring chiropractors to maintain accurate, contemporaneous, and secure clinical records.

The Dental Council of New Zealand (DCNZ) sets the standards for dental practice,  mandating rigorous record-keeping, informed consent, and clinical safety  protocols for all registered oral health practitioners.

The Medical Council of New Zealand (MCNZ) sets the standards for medical practice, requiring GPs to maintain clear, accurate, and contemporaneous records that ensure continuity of care and patient safety under the HPCA Act.
The NZSTA Code of Ethics provides the professional framework for speech-language therapists in New Zealand, ensuring high standards of clinical practice, record-keeping, and ethical conduct.

The Osteopathic Council of New Zealand (OCNZ) sets the standards of clinical practice, ethics, and record-keeping for all registered osteopaths under the Health Practitioners Competence Assurance (HPCA) Act 2003.

fullName: Occupational Therapy Board of New Zealand
summary: The Occupational Therapy Board of New Zealand (OTBNZ) sets the standards for practice, conduct, and ethics for OTs under the Health Practitioners Competence Assurance (HPCA) Act 2003.
The Physiotherapy Board of New Zealand (PBNZ) sets the standards of clinical and professional behaviour for physiotherapists under the Health Practitioners Competence Assurance (HPCA) Act 2003.

The Podiatrists Board of New Zealand (PBNZ) sets the standards for podiatric practice,  diabetic foot care, and clinical record-keeping under the Health Practitioners  Competence Assurance (HPCA) Act 2003.
The Veterinary Council of New Zealand (VCNZ) sets the statutory standards for veterinary practice, requiring contemporaneous, attributable, and accurate clinical records for all animal patients.

fullName: American Animal Hospital Association Standards of Accreditation
summary: AAHA accreditation is a voluntary but widely adopted quality standard for US small-animal veterinary practices. Standards cover clinical records, anaesthesia, surgery, pharmacy, dental, and pain management. Only ~15% of US practices are AAHA-accredited.

fullName: American Dental Association (ADA) + Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA)
summary: This framework ensures dental practices maintain clinical records compliant with ADA CDT coding standards and HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules.

fullName: American Medical Association + Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (US)
summary: This framework integrates the AMA Code of Medical Ethics with HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules to ensure US general practitioners maintain compliant, contemporaneous, and secure clinical records.
The APMA and individual state podiatry boards set the standards for clinical documentation, scope of practice, and infection control for podiatric physicians across the United States.

ASHA sets the national standards for speech-language pathology and audiology, mandating rigorous documentation of clinical intervention, outcome measures, and ethical practice for all Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) holders.

fullName: American Veterinary Medical Association + American Animal Hospital Association
summary: The AVMA and AAHA set the national standards for veterinary medical records, controlled substance management, and clinical practice in the United States.

fullName: Federation of State Boards of Physical Therapy
summary: The FSBPT provides the Model Practice Act and standards for physical therapy regulation across US jurisdictions, ensuring safe, ethical, and competent practice through standardized record-keeping and supervision requirements.
The NBCE and state chiropractic boards mandate rigorous, contemporaneous, and evidence-based documentation for all chiropractic adjustments and clinical interventions.

fullName: National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy
summary: The NBCOT Practice Standards define the professional responsibilities and record-keeping expectations for Occupational Therapists in the United States.
